Source SHA-256: `ffab1bce84681fab25a13c4bb01bb52551f921403859a36d5471ef309aa3bc9d`.

Evidence: `checks/audits_v3/cdb136a26980.json`.

**A2 — reproduced training-support gap, not a canonical-ambiguous rival.**
The Racket rule mirrors colored cells from either side of a row's 9 anchor. A
left-origin-only copier matches all 384/384 generated outputs because no sampled
input has a right-origin colored cell. There are 370 distinct inputs. However,
that rival fails **all 3/3 canonical pairs**; canonical evidence already refutes
it. It would be incorrect to claim this rival fits the canonical demonstrations.

Exact **8×12** counterexample (horizontal reflection of the default medium
`generate(0,0)` draw):

```text
000000000000
000000000000
000000000000
000000096020
000000000000
000000000000
000090300000
000000009125
```

Racket copies the right-origin cells to the left of each anchor. For example,
in row 3, anchor column 7, color 6 at column 8 maps to column 6 and color 2 at
column 10 maps to column 4. The one-sided rival does not add those cells. The
validator accepts this input; the complete authoritative and rival outputs are
retained. The task's source description should acknowledge both directions.

**A2b — ignored override, reproduced.** With
`generate(0,0,difficulty="easy",marks_per_row=1)`, active rows contain `[1,2,3]`
marks, not one mark each. Recommended direction: balanced left/right source
profiles, canonical offset coverage, and a realized mark-count axis. There was
no fix to this task, and no claim about untested seeds or learner performance.

## Audit-tool failures retained

The first audit attempt assumed integer cells; the second assumed test examples
were always a list. Canonical storage also has row strings and singleton test
dictionaries. Both failures are retained in `checks/logs/audit_targets*.log`; the
third run succeeds after normalization. Two local tests guard these variants.
These were bugs in my new audit script, not new defects attributed to the two
source generators. The final audit report is `checks/audits_v3/`, not the earlier
empty/failed output directories.

triage.reason: Both audits fully read and transported; counts remain reviewer-reported until separate target inspection and reproduction. Longest-wire canonical-compatible rival is distinct from canonical-refuted left-origin support gap.
